verdict.rationale: Performance and item caps at large scale are a fair question for a task-tracking product, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of card, board or workspace limits, and no performance data for workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks. The only performance mention is one anecdote about slow board creation, which says nothing about behavior at scale.

support.subject: As an engineer, I know how the product performs and whether item caps apply in workspaces with tens of thousands of tasks
